subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — responsibility matrix and exhibit ownership
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — responsibility matrix and exhibit ownership

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I'm kicking off the MSA / Order Form intake so we have a single place to track party info, responsibilities, and which exhibits will be customer-supplied vs Redwood standard. To keep the contracting timeline tight (~2 weeks for initial counters), can you please provide the following by Wednesday EOD (June 9):

- Confirm counterparty legal name and billing entity (exact legal entity)
- Primary contracting contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Any mandatory contract terms (e.g., PO requirements, address, payment net terms)
- SOC 2 / security evidence or a pointer to where we can fetch it (link or attachments)
- If Halcyon has a preferred SOW template, send the most recent draft

I've attached: 1) redwood_MSA_template_v3.docx (our starting template) and 2) a blank party-responsibility-matrix.xlsx we use to capture who owns each exhibit and signing authority.

Internal note: Marissa — please start a responsibility matrix draft (assign exhibits: SLA, Data Processing Addendum, Billing) and tag Karthik for any commercial exceptions.

Next steps I propose:
- Daniel confirms items above + returns Halcyon SOW draft (attachment)
- Redwood returns marked MSA within 48 hours after we receive the party data
- Quick legal sync if Halcyon has significant preferred terms (we can do a 30‑minute call)

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_MSA_template_v3.docx (docx), party-responsibility-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — responsibility matrix and exhibit ownership

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear list and the template. Quick answers inline below and attaching our SOW draft: Halcyon_SOW_draft_v1.pdf.

- Legal name / billing entity: Halcyon Analytics, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789)
- Contracting contact: Daniel Park, Head of Partnerships, daniel.park@halcyon.ai, +1 (415) 555-0123
- Payment terms: standard 30 days; we do sometimes require a PO number to be on invoices
- Mandatory terms: we prefer limitation of liability capped at fees paid in prior 12 months; will flag formally via our legal team if different
- SOC2: we can share an access link to our security portal; legal@halcyon.ai will send a link by EOD tomorrow

We can accept Redwood's MSA template as a starting point; any material deviations will be shared by legal.

If helpful, I can set up a 30-minute call between our legal counsel and Marissa / Karthik on Thursday.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of Partnerships
Halcyon Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — responsibility matrix and exhibit ownership

Thanks Daniel — helpful. I've started the responsibility matrix and attached the working file (party-responsibility-matrix.xlsx). A few operational clarifications from contracting:

1) Exhibits and ownership (initial proposal):
   - Exhibit A (Services / SOW): Halcyon to provide final SOW text; Redwood to convert into Order Form attachments
   - Exhibit B (Billing & Payment): Redwood to draft standard billing exhibit; Halcyon to confirm PO flow and billing contact
   - Exhibit C (SLA & Support): Redwood standard SLA; if Halcyon needs higher uptime SLA we can discuss pricing adjustments
   - DPA / Privacy Exhibit: Halcyon to confirm any additional DPA clauses beyond our standard (we will provide Redwood DPA draft)

2) Commercial exceptions: Karthik — can you confirm whether we're comfortable with a liability cap of fees paid in prior 12 months for this ARR band? If not, propose alternatives.

3) Evidence collection: Halcyon legal — once you send the SOC 2 link, Soojin will intake the evidence and map to our vendor checklist. Helpful if you include report date and scope.

4) Proposed cadence: Redwood will return a marked MSA within 48 hours after party info is final. Please confirm whether Halcyon prefers DocuSign or countersign via a procurement portal.

I'll drop comments into the MSA template (redwood_MSA_template_v3.docx) after we get the SOC 2 link.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Contracts & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: party-responsibility-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — responsibility matrix and exhibit ownership

Looping in from legal side — quick guidance so the team can prepare:

- Liability cap: For customers with expected ARR < $250k we typically accept a liability cap equal to fees paid in prior 12 months. If Halcyon expects larger commit, escalate for commercial approval.
- PO requirement: We can accept a PO on invoices but need a billing contact for procurement exceptions and an invoice routing address (please supply).
- SLA changes: Any SLA above our standard (99.5%) will likely require a pricing uplift or a service credit structure; Marissa, please draft a short options table we can present.
- Signature flow: DocuSign is preferred; if Halcyon requires a procurement portal we can accommodate but it adds a step to delivery.

Daniel — when you have the SOC 2 link, please include the report date and auditor name. Soojin will run the evidence intake and confirm if a security questionnaire is still needed.

If Halcyon legal wants a 30-minute sync, I am available Thursday 11:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
